label: sdc01_0060_caretaker_02
text: All right, everyone! This is the community center![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0060_caretaker_03
text: This is where you’ll be staying while you’re here\nin Kitakami.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0060_caretaker_04
text: The plan was to have you and the students from\nBlueberry Academy stay here together...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0060_caretaker_05
text: but it turns out this space is going to be all for\nyou—our visitors from Naranja Academy![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0060_caretaker_06

label: sdc01_0060_bbteacher_02
text: Oh, right... Those two kids were originally from\nthis town, weren’t they...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0060_caretaker_07
